description: Price history of one asset for charts (GET /v1/rates/series). Crypto: every range. Fiat: 1d and 7d from rate-hub's own readings taken about every 30 minutes; 30d, 90d, 1y and max one point per UTC day from the daily archive (it has a start day, days without a document are skipped, a cold range fills over a few retries, so an early answer may have fewer points). A fiat with no reading in the range, or an unknown uid, answers status unsupported with empty points, not an error. status: ok = fresh series; stale = last cached series, upstream failed (see fetched_at); pending = not ready, retry after retry_after seconds; unsupported = unknown uid, an asset no upstream knows, or a fiat with no reading in the range. Size: about 110 bytes per point (both copies of the result). max_points (2..500, default 100) downsamples evenly and keeps the first and last point; pass 500 for full detail. A non-USD fiat quote clips the series at the start of the fiat archive (range max only), and with a dynamic coin an unsupported answer may mean its uid expired. Edge cases: read resource ratehub://docs/behavior (behaviour notes).

max_points.description: Downsample to at most this many points, 2..500 (default 100); first and last points are kept

uid.description: Catalog uid of a crypto asset
